translated_blocks.translated_text: "Step 3: Fill in the form that is included with this letter. Do you have more annual statements? For example, because your child went to more than one childcare facility in 2024? Then copy or print them all. Write your citizen service number (bsn) in the top right corner of each copy. Sometimes you can find the annual statement in the digital portal of the childcare facility."

translated_blocks.translated_text: "Step 4: Send the annual statement and the form before July 11, 2025. The data you need for this can be found on the annual statement from the childcare. Do you have more annual statements? For example, because your child went to more than one childcare in 2024? Then copy or print them all. Write your citizen service number (bsn) at the top right of each copy. Don't have an annual statement? Then send copies of all invoices from 2024. The childcare will email the annual statement or send it to you by post. Sometimes you can find the annual statement in the digital portal of the childcare."
